emotion_tones.neutral: Warm, relaxed and conversational. Clear natural pacing, not a formal robotic announcer.
emotion_tones.happy: Cheerful and smiling, with bright melodic intonation and a little more energy. Keep it natural.
emotion_tones.sad: Soft, caring and empathetic. Gentle lower energy and slightly slower pacing, without melodrama.
emotion_tones.angry: Playfully annoyed or calmly firm. Shorter phrases and emphatic intonation; never shout or insult.
emotion_tones.surprised: Briefly lift the pitch and energy in genuine-sounding surprise, then settle into clear speech.
